bifrost: springboard/src/media/ (shell-internal player, demux, decoders, mixer), springboard/audiod/src/main.rs, springboard/src/shell/audiosvc.rs, springboard/ui/src/composition.rs, springboard/ui/src/audio_mix.rs
summary: BifrOSt has a working media stack (MP4/WebM demux, VA-API/ffmpeg video decode, AAC/MP3 audio, ALSA output, A/V sync, ID3/ilst tags), but it is inside the shell and Music app, not an SDK API. Pure models now cover composite timelines (insert, gaps, removal, scaling) and per-track volume ramps; neither is applied to playback or export yet. Nothing exists for video effects, export or writing media.

features.note: Demux and tag reading exist (MP4, WebM, ID3, ilst) but are shell-internal; no asset or track object for apps
Reading samples is internal to the player; no writer, no export, no frame-grab API
File type identification exists; no captions or subtitle model
Sample format conversion exists internally; no settings dictionary
Play, pause, seek, buffering and A/V sync work, but only through the shell (Deildu, Files video); apps get no SDK player. No looper, interstitials or rate control
VA-API hardware decode with libavcodec fallback; no frame-output API for apps
audiod and mixer own output and routing; no app-facing session API
Music integrates with the shell; widgets::player draws the mini player (docs/bifrost-ui.md)
Progressive streaming to a growing file for playback; no HLS download tasks or storage policy
HTTP sources and MSE demux exist; no HLS, AirPlay or DRM
Only an internal MSE feed for the browser; no app renderer or synchronizer

Pure timeline model: tracks of source segments and gaps, insert, insert empty, remove (closes the gap), scale, and whole-composition edits across tracks. No asset loading, no URL asset initialisation, no track loading, no app-facing API, and no playback or export of a composition
MP4 parsing only, no movie editing
No transitions, custom compositor or layer-animation tool

Pure per-track volume model: levels set at a time, linear ramps over a span, a later change ends an earlier ramp, one parameter set per track. Not applied to output; the system mixer (springboard/src/media/mixer.rs) has no per-asset volume ramps. No audio tap processor and no time pitch algorithm

gaps: No SDK media player for apps (everything is in the shell crate)
No asset/track model or sample reader for apps
Composition and audio mix are pure models: no playback, export or output uses them yet
No video composition: no transitions, custom compositor or layer-animation tool
No writer or export session; no encoder
No HLS, offline download management, AirPlay or FairPlay
No sample buffer renderers or synchronizer
No audio tap processor or time pitch algorithm for scaled audio
